dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped structures exhibit high-contrast light-grey perimeters with jagged inner edges transitioning abruptly to dark-grey/black interiors, most prominent along the mid-dorsal and lateral sections.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Clusters of solid, low-gradient light-grey pixel concentrations are densely packed along the lower lateral flank and anterior neck region, forming asymmetrical shapes without internal rings.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of three prominent annuli on the upper mid-flank form an obtuse scalene triangle; a cluster of four smaller annuli posterior to these forms a roughly diamond-shaped polygon.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A small, circular, darker-pigmented indentation or lesion is visible on the upper proximal surface of the left hind flipper.
other_distinctive_markers: The high density and close proximity of the light-grey ring patterns create a near-continuous honeycomb texture across the primary torso.
